verdict.rationale: The evidence shows a first-party client-side integration surface, Plaid Link, with documented callbacks (onEvent, onSuccess) that developers build against for the IDV flow, which suggests SDK-style tooling. It never explicitly names official SDKs or server-side client libraries, and the OpenAPI probe found no published spec. missing for 10: explicit documentation of official SDKs/client libraries and supported languages, server-side SDK coverage of IDV endpoints, a published OpenAPI spec, independent or hands-on corroboration.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can build against official SDKs

citations.quote: After integrating Identity Verification using Link, you can use Link's client-side callbacks to see how your users are progressing through the flow.
onEvent will fire at certain points throughout the IDV flow with updates on the user's progress at each point.
onSuccess will fire when a user has successfully completed the Link flow.
